source_event: NEURO_CAV1_PCREB_H3K9AC (CaV1 L-type Ca2+ influx -> pCREB -> NeuroD1/Ngn1 promoter H3K9ac)
target_event: NEURO_DG_NEUROGENESIS (Adult hippocampal DG BrdU+/DCX+ & BrdU+/NeuN+ neurogenesis)
supporting_quote: Interestingly, these epigenetic effects were prevented by nifedipine, thus confirming a pivotal role of Cav1 channel
intervention_or_joint_measurement: 5 µM nifedipine CaV1 blockade in vitro (E1.1); separate in vivo DG stereology cohort (E1.2/E1.3)
tissue_scope: Hippocampal neural stem cells (dish) & dentate gyrus (in vivo)
life_stage_scope: Adult male mouse (4-5 weeks at start) & cultured adult NSCs
context_limitations: Nifedipine blockade was performed in cultured NSCs (E1.1), whereas BrdU+/DCX+ and BrdU+/NeuN+ counts (E1.2/E1.3) were measured in separate in vivo cohorts without in vivo conditional CaV1 knockout.

source_event: NEURO_HIPP_NMDAR_GLUN2 (Hippocampal GluN2A & GluN2B NMDAR subunit protein expression, E6.1)
target_event: NEURO_HIPP_CA1_LTP_EXCITABILITY (Hippocampal CA1 Schaffer-collateral LTP induction efficacy, E5.1/E5.2)
supporting_citation: Li et al., 2014 (Environ Res) & Varró et al., 2009 (Bioelectromagnetics)
supporting_quote: Perfusion of Mg2+-free solution results in the removal of the Mg2+ from the NMDA-type glutamate receptor... whole-body exposure enhanced the efficacy of LTP induction, especially in the WhB 15 group
intervention_or_joint_measurement: Cross-study hypothesis only: Li 2014 measured GluN2A/2B protein without electrophysiology; Varró 2009 measured CA1 LTP without GluN2 blot
species_scope: Rat (adult male Sprague-Dawley in E6; adult male Wistar in E5)
tissue_scope: Hippocampus (whole hippocampal extract in E6 vs. CA1 slice in E5)
life_stage_scope: Adult male rat (14-day exposure in E6 vs. 15-day exposure in E5)
context_limitations: Total GluN2A/2B protein elevation in E6 does not prove synaptic surface insertion or conductances in E5; E5 raw text also has µT/mT OCR prefix ambiguity. Supports a combined blot+LTP experiment in the same rat cohort.

target_event: NEURO_CALYX_CAV2_CHANNEL (Auditory brainstem calyx of Held presynaptic CaV2.1/CaV2.3 protein, E2.1/E2.2)
supporting_citation: Leone et al., 2014 & Sun et al., 2016
supporting_quote: Western blots showed that all three subtypes of calcium channels are expressed at higher levels in the ELF-EMF exposure group
intervention_or_joint_measurement: Separate studies, cell types, and brain regions (adult hippocampal NSCs vs. neonatal P8-P10 auditory brainstem calyx)
tissue_scope: Hippocampal NSCs vs. Auditory brainstem calyx of Held (NON-EQUIVALENT brain regions)
context_limitations: CaV1 (L-type) in hippocampal stem cells and CaV2.1/2.3 (P/Q & R-type) in neonatal auditory brainstem terminals belong to the voltage-gated Ca2+ channel superfamily under 50 Hz 1 mT, but MUST NOT be stitched into a single hippocampal memory pathway.

source_event: NEURO_DG_NEUROGENESIS / NEURO_HIPP_NEURON_SYNAPSE_SURVIVAL (Mouse DG neurogenesis E1.2/1.3 & CA3 survival E3.2)
supporting_quote: number of NeuN-positive cells in the CA3 area deceased in 3xTg-SE... whole-body exposure enhanced the efficacy of LTP induction
intervention_or_joint_measurement: No single study measured DG neurogenesis, CA3 survival, and CA1 LTP simultaneously

source_event: NEURO_MWM_SPATIAL_MEMORY (Morris water maze spatial reference learning, E1.4/E3.3/E6.2/E6.3)
supporting_quote: ELFEFs showed a significant reduction in the latency to find... ELFEF-exposed mice showed a higher discrimination ability
intervention_or_joint_measurement: E1 measured both MWM and NOR in the same study; E4 measured Y-maze under restraint/implant
context_limitations: Morris water maze (multi-day spatial reference memory), Y-maze (acute trial working memory under restraint/implant), and NOR (recognition memory) tax distinct cognitive sub-processes and stress levels; opposite directions (E1.4/E1.5 improved vs. E4.2 impaired) reflect protocol/task differences, not a simple dose law.

supporting_citation: Houston et al., 2018 (Front Public Health) & Li et al., 2018 (Cell Physiol Biochem)

intervention_or_joint_measurement: Houston 2018 compared GC-1/GC-2 vs. mature sperm at 0.15 W/kg (2-6 h CW); Li 2018 tested melatonin & AMPKalpha2 manipulation in GC-2 at 4.0 W/kg (24 h GSM-Talk)
species_scope: Mouse (GC-1/GC-2 cell lines & isolated cauda spermatozoa)
tissue_scope: In vitro male germ-cell lines and isolated mature spermatozoa
life_stage_scope: Pre-meiotic/meiotic precursor lines vs. post-meiotic spermatozoa
context_limitations: F1 used 1800 MHz CW at 0.15 W/kg for 2-6 h, whereas F2 used 1800 MHz GSM-Talk at 4.0 W/kg for 24 h (5m on/10m off). Li 2018's AMPK/autophagy findings support an intracellular mechanism within GC-2 at 4.0 W/kg, and provide a testable hypothesis—not direct proof—for why GC-1/GC-2 in F1 did not accumulate 8-OHdG at 0.15 W/kg.

supporting_quote: The alkaline comet assay was performed to detect the DNA single- and double-strand breaks as well as alkali labile sites, and the neutral comet assay was carried out to detect DNA double-strand breaks
intervention_or_joint_measurement: Same 4.0 W/kg 24 h GC-2 cell batch assayed by both alkaline comet, neutral comet, and gamma-H2AX blot
context_limitations: Positive alkaline comet with negative neutral comet/gamma-H2AX demonstrates lesion-spectrum/assay-channel specificity under that protocol; it does not prove absolute absence of any DSB or universal reversibility.

target_event: REPRO_SPERM_COUNT_AND_MORPHOLOGY (Cauda epididymal / ejaculated sperm concentration & count, F5.1a/F4.1/F7.2/R6.5/R6.6)
supporting_citation: Imai et al., 2011 (Syst Biol Reprod Med)
supporting_quote: No significant differences were observed among these values except for the sperm count in the testes, which was significantly greater in the high level exposure group than with the sham exposure.
intervention_or_joint_measurement: Imai 2011 Table 2 simultaneously measured testicular sperm count and epididymal sperm count in the same 24 rats/group
